notes.title: The Legend of Gandar III
notes.content:
An epic fantasy world returns.
This is the next chapter of the highly anticipated The Legend of Gandar III installment, developed by Jeddead.
The Legend of Gandar III takes place two years after the events of The Legend of Gandar II and The Legend of Gandar.
This game will feature several more challenging bosses, dungeons, and enemies.
It will also feature new and epic soundtracks.
